audit.whatIsWrong: The two layers disagreed on six of seven rows. Full read Talon/Skill/Skill/Skill/Fizz/Skill/Skill; content win[] and the packet chart both read Fizz/Talon/Talon/Talon/Fizz/Fizz/Fizz.
audit.why: Level 1 Talon has only a 575 Q and no Rake, so your W last-hits and minion-walk win it. Levels 2-5 belong to him: Rake at 9s plus the Noxian Diplomacy leap and Blade's End bleed out-damage your string. From 6 the shark and then items flip it back.
audit.corrected: Full layer moved onto the content/packet verdicts, with every affected why rewritten to argue the same side; ratings for rows 1-3 dropped to 4/10.

audit.why: Rake rank 1 at 9s is the level 2 spike, Shadow Assault at 100/80/60s is the level 6 spike, and first item flips the duel — all four spikes[] entries exist and are accurate once the ability names are fixed.
audit.corrected: spikes[0].text corrected for names; the rest left.

audit.whatIsWrong: Five fields called Talon's Q 'Cutthroat' and one called Rake his E. spikes[0] also described Blade's End as an execute.
audit.why: Per the kit: Q is Noxian Diplomacy (8/7.5/7/6.5/6, 575, leaps if out of melee and crits in melee), W is Rake (9/8.5/8/7.5/7, 650, the return blades slow and carry the damage), E is Assassin's Path (no cost, no cooldown, but each vaulted wall goes on a long cooldown). Blade's End stacks three times and then bleeds — it is damage over time, not a threshold execute.
audit.corrected: Real names used throughout; Blade's End described as a heavy bleed; Assassin's Path's zero cost and per-wall cooldown now stated as the thing that decides where his engage comes from.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT), and dosFull[2].d called Rake a 'fifteen-second invitation'.
audit.why: Rake is 9s at rank 1, not 15. A magnitude with no source is the defect the catalogue names.
audit.corrected: Rake 9s, Noxian Diplomacy 8s, Assassin's Path's per-wall cooldown all written in; the bullet now says nine seconds.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d was tradeGood verbatim and dontsFull[2].d was tradeBad verbatim (lint COPY_PASTE_BLEED).
audit.why: Bodies did not match their titles.
audit.corrected: Both rewritten around the untargetability window and the Q crit.

notes: 'Cutthroat' is a fabricated ability name — it appeared in whys[1], spikes[0].text, early and wants.foe[0], and wants.foe[0] additionally labelled Rake as his E. Corrected to Noxian Diplomacy (Q) and Rake (W) with Assassin's Path as E. Blade's End was described as an execute; Riot's text makes it a three-stack bleed, so I wrote bleed. The full-layer chart disagreed with content win[] on six of seven rows; I moved the full layer onto the content/packet verdicts and rewrote every affected why, so no win[N] edits were needed. Rake's derived flags list knockup but Riot's description only gives a slow on the return, so I asserted the slow and not a displacement — the missingInteractions 'knockup-enabler' entry rests on that flag and I did not act on it. Talon's suspectNames entries ('Use Shadow Assault', "Shadow Assault's") are false positives; the name is correct.
